title_zh: 你看不上的生意，正在赚钱
title_en: The Businesses You Look Down On Are Making Money
desc_zh: 拍照评腹肌的 App 月入五位数，被断言一句话就能抄死的 AI 套壳晒出亿级年收入，被裁的人比在岗贵——本周商业情报，另附七个我们亲手否掉的方向。
desc_en: An abs-rating app clears five figures a month, "copyable" AI wrappers flaunt nine-figure revenue, and laid-off experts cost more than employed ones — this week's business intel, plus seven directions we killed after reading the comments.
